text: taṇhāsuttaṃ [182] kenassu nīyati loko kenassu parikissati kissassa ekadhammassa sabbeva vasamanvagūti . [183] taṇhāya nīyati loko taṇhāya parikissati taṇhāya ekadhammassa sabbeva vasamanvagūti . #1 sī. aṭṭhabhavi . yu. addhabhavi . a. andabhavītipi andhabhavītipi pāṭho . #2 bhīyotipipāṭho . 3 sabbattha kissassu . 4 po. ma. parikassati . catutthaṃ
